snippet.title: Undockable | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Undockable now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3957950/Undockable/ 

Survive as Hjorti — a living heart in a chaotic game world! Build modular weapons, face endless enemies, outsmart unique bosses, and enjoy dark humor. Craft your strategy, mix deadly combos, and survive the madness!
